newsitem.title: UK: Spirax-Sarco buys United Dominion units.
newsitem.headline: Spirax-Sarco buys United Dominion units.

text.p: Britain's Spirax-Sarco Engineering Plc said on Thursday it had bought businesses in the Netherlands and the U.S. from United Dominion Industries Ltd of Canada for about 17 million stg.
Spirax-Sarco said it had acquired Bredel Holdings, a maker of peristaltic pumps based in the Netherlands, and the associated Bredel distribution business of Waukesha Cherry Burrell in the U.S.
"The acquisition is forecast to provide an immediate benefit to group earnings," Spirax-Sarco said in a statement.
The price paid was subject to a maximum additional payment of about 1.0 million stg according to results achieved in 1996 and the level of net assets at completion.
The company said it would pay for the purchases from borrowings.
As of November, the acquired businesses had net assets of 3.6 million stg on a cash and debt free basis and generated an 11-month profit before interest and tax of 1.7 million stg.
